name: Rednukem
description:
Rednukem is an open-source BUILD engine source port based on EDuke32, providing native 64-bit support for the classic redneck shooters: Redneck Rampage, Redneck Rampage Rides Again, and Redneck Deer Huntin'.

Features:
- Native Linux execution with high-resolution widescreen rendering
- Modern mouselook controls, customizable key bindings, and gamepad support
- Accurate physics, sound effects, and level triggers matching original DOS behavior
- High-fidelity audio playback supporting CD audio soundtrack tracks
- Uncapped framerates and performance optimizations eliminating engine slowdowns
